Qualifying income exactly £50,000 in 2024-25 — MTD from April 2026? — conversation 2

HMRC’s wording is “more than £50,000”, so the threshold is exclusive of the exact amount. The 6 April 2026 start date applies only if qualifying income was more than £50,000 for 2024-25.

Official guidance: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-out-if-and-when-you-need-to-use-making-tax-digital-for-income-tax
Sorry I meant £55,000 qualifying income in 2024-25

Based on verified HMRC / GOV.UK guidance: [mtd-threshold-50k-april-2026] MTD Income Tax £50,000 threshold starts 6 April 2026 (2025-26, 2026-27, 2027-28): If your qualifying income was more than £50,000 for the 2024-25 tax year (2024 to 2025), you need to use Making Tax Digital for Income Tax from 6 April 2026. Qualifying income is total self-employment and property income before expenses (turnover/gross), not profit. Do not confuse this £50,000 / April 2026 band with the later £30,000 / April 2027 band. (source: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-out-if-and-when-you-need-to-use-making-tax-digital-for-income-tax)
